interpretation: The simple reconstructor-frequency-band coordinate discovered in P14-D1 does not independently confirm.
Its sign reverses at the pooled level in confirm80 relative to the development fresh80.
The reversal is not rescued by method stratification: both CFOP and NONCFOP show negative dominant-minus-nondominant gaps.

Era stratification reveals a strong sign split: E1/E2 positive, E3/E4 negative. Because this interaction was secondary in P14, it is hypothesis-generating only and cannot rescue the failed primary verdict.

Across P13 and P14, named metadata axes repeatedly fail stable sign ownership while composition cancellation/heterogeneity persists. The surviving object is therefore nonstationary mixture structure rather than a promoted method or reconstructor label.
